apps.name: 阿里云盘每日签到
apps.author: taotie6
apps.description: 阿里云盘每日签到与奖励领取，支持白虎机密变量、单账号和多账号。

env_schema.label: 单账号 Refresh Token
env_schema.description: 阿里云盘 refresh_token；单账号与多账号配置二选一。

env_schema.label: 多账号 JSON
env_schema.description: JSON 数组；每项支持 label 及 refresh_token/refreshToken。配置后优先于单账号。

env_schema.label: 账号文件路径
env_schema.description: 可选；已挂载账号 JSON 路径，兼容含 ALIYUN 数组的原 config.json。

scenarios.name: 每日签到
scenarios.description: 每天 08:40 执行签到并领取奖励，随机延迟最多 5 分钟。

apps.manifest_raw:
spec_version: "v1"
id: "aliyundrive-checkin"
name: "阿里云盘每日签到"
version: "1.0.0"
author: "taotie6"
category: "福利签到"
last_commit: "2026-10-19T00:00:00+08:00"
template:
  - tag: "AliyunDriveCheckin"
  - mise_languages: "python@3.12.11"
description: "阿里云盘每日签到与奖励领取，支持白虎机密变量、单账号和多账号。"
homepage: "https://www.aliyundrive.com"
build_opts:
  force_setup: false
  skip_setup: false
  skip_sync: false
  overwrite_env: false
  overwrite_task: true
schedule_opts:
  schedule: "0 40 8 * * *"
  random_range: 300
  timeout: 5
  retry_count: 1
  retry_interval: 60
sources:
  - id: "repo"
    source_type: "git"
    source_url: "https://github.com/taotie6/baihu-scripts.git"
    branch: "main"
    target_path: "repo"
setup:
  check: >-
    mise exec {mise_languages} -- python -c "import requests"
    && mise exec {mise_languages} -- python -m py_compile
    "{app_dir}/repo/apps/aliyundrive-checkin/main/checkin.py"
  install: |
    mise install {mise_languages}
    mise exec {mise_languages} -- python -m pip install -r "{app_dir}/repo/apps/aliyundrive-checkin/main/requirements.txt"
    mise exec {mise_languages} -- python -m py_compile "{app_dir}/repo/apps/aliyundrive-checkin/main/checkin.py"
env_schema:
  - key: "ALIYUNDRIVE_REFRESH_TOKEN"
    label: "单账号 Refresh Token"
    type: "secret"
    required: false
    description: "阿里云盘 refresh_token；单账号与多账号配置二选一。"
  - key: "ALIYUNDRIVE_ACCOUNTS"
    label: "多账号 JSON"
    type: "secret"
    required: false
    description: "JSON 数组；每项支持 label 及 refresh_token/refreshToken。配置后优先于单账号。"
    placeholder: '[{"label":"账号1","refresh_token":"..."}]'
  - key: "ALIYUNDRIVE_ACCOUNTS_FILE"
    label: "账号文件路径"
    type: "string"
    required: false
    description: "可选；已挂载账号 JSON 路径，兼容含 ALIYUN 数组的原 config.json。"
sync_rules:
  defaults:
    timeout: 5
    retry_count: 1
    retry_interval: 60
    work_dir: "{app_dir}/repo/apps/aliyundrive-checkin/main"
    language: "{mise_languages}"
  tasks:
    - id: "daily-checkin"
      name: "阿里云盘每日签到"
      source: "repo"
      language: "{mise_languages}"
      command: "python checkin.py"
      default_cron: "0 40 8 * * *"
      enabled: true
scenarios:
  - id: "standard"
    name: "每日签到"
    description: "每天 08:40 执行签到并领取奖励，随机延迟最多 5 分钟。"
    default: true
    task_presets:
      daily-checkin:
        enabled: true
        cron: "0 40 8 * * *"

    description: "JSON 数组；每项支持 token、cookie、userAgent/ua、label。配置后优先于单账号。"
    placeholder: '[{"label":"账号1","token":"xxx","cookie":"","userAgent":"Mozilla/5.0 ..."}]'

    timeout: 5

    language: "{mise_languages}"

    - id: "daily-checkin"
      name: "iios.fun 每日签到"
      source: "repo"
      language: "{mise_languages}"
      command: "node run.cjs"

      enabled: true

env_schema.label: 登录态挂载目录
env_schema.description: 可选；白虎主机中包含 *.info 文件的已挂载目录。通常直接使用上方机密变量即可。

scenarios.name: 每日领取
scenarios.description: 每天 08:20 执行，随机延迟最多 5 分钟。

apps.manifest_raw:
spec_version: "v1"
id: "workbuddy-checkin"
name: "WorkBuddy 每日积分"
version: "1.0.0"
author: "taotie6"
category: "福利签到"
last_commit: "2026-10-19T00:00:00+08:00"
template:
  - tag: "WorkBuddyCheckin"
  - mise_languages: "python@3.12.11"
description: "WorkBuddy 每日积分自动领取，支持导入单个或多个登录态及 5.6.0+ 加密登录态。"
homepage: "https://copilot.tencent.com"
build_opts:
  force_setup: false
  skip_setup: false
  skip_sync: false
  overwrite_env: false
  overwrite_task: true
schedule_opts:
  schedule: "0 20 8 * * *"
  random_range: 300
  timeout: 5
  retry_count: 1
  retry_interval: 60
sources:
  - id: "repo"
    source_type: "git"
    source_url: "https://github.com/taotie6/baihu-scripts.git"
    branch: "main"
    target_path: "repo"
setup:
  check: >-
    mise exec {mise_languages} -- python -c
    "import requests; from Crypto.Cipher import AES"
    && mise exec {mise_languages} -- python -m py_compile
    "{app_dir}/repo/apps/workbuddy-checkin/main/checkin.py"
  install: |
    mise install {mise_languages}
    mise exec {mise_languages} -- python -m pip install -r "{app_dir}/repo/apps/workbuddy-checkin/main/requirements.txt"
    mise exec {mise_languages} -- python -m py_compile "{app_dir}/repo/apps/workbuddy-checkin/main/checkin.py"
env_schema:
  - key: "WORKBUDDY_SESSIONS"
    label: "WorkBuddy 登录态 JSON"
    type: "secret"
    required: false
    description: "粘贴一个完整 .info JSON 对象；多账号请填写由多个完整对象组成的 JSON 数组。"
    placeholder: '{"account":{"uid":"..."},"auth":{"accessToken":...,"expiresAt":...}}'
  - key: "WORKBUDDY_AUTH_DIR"
    label: "登录态挂载目录"
    type: "string"
    required: false
    description: "可选；白虎主机中包含 *.info 文件的已挂载目录。通常直接使用上方机密变量即可。"
sync_rules:
  defaults:
    timeout: 5
    retry_count: 1
    retry_interval: 60
    work_dir: "{app_dir}/repo/apps/workbuddy-checkin/main"
    language: "{mise_languages}"
  tasks:
    - id: "daily-checkin"
      name: "WorkBuddy 每日积分"
      source: "repo"
      language: "{mise_languages}"
      command: "python checkin.py"
      default_cron: "0 20 8 * * *"
      enabled: true
scenarios:
  - id: "standard"
    name: "每日领取"
    description: "每天 08:20 执行，随机延迟最多 5 分钟。"
    default: true
    task_presets:
      daily-checkin:
        enabled: true
        cron: "0 20 8 * * *"
